summary: Myseum.AI, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on May 18, 2026, under Items 8.01 (Other Events) and 9.01 (Financial Statements and Exhibits) solely to furnish a shareholder letter and corporate update. The letter details the company's strategic focus on a privacy-first, localized agentic AI platform, including its Picture Party social sharing platform launched in January 2026, but contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring. The filing is a routine update to shareholders and does not trigger any special-situations classification.
